notes.title: The Aeterna Lucis Demo Is Now Available!
notes.notes:
[p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44789402/0abf151b5ac28cce51d4ef58d38842d93a29a343.jpg"][/img][/p][h2]🎮 [b]The Aeterna Lucis Demo Is Now Available![/b][/h2][p]After 4 years of development, countless challenges, endless fine-tuning, and yes… [i]millions of deaths[/i] adjusting every jump to perfection, we’re proud to finally share a very special moment with all of you:
[b]The demo of Aeterna Lucis is now live on Steam.[/b][/p][p]Many of you have been with us since the beginning with [i]Aeterna Noctis[/i], and today we can proudly say that [b]its sequel is closer than ever[/b].
Now more than ever, we need your support.[/p][hr][/hr][h2]💬 [b]We want to hear from you![/b][/h2][p]This demo is more than just a preview — it’s an open invitation to our amazing community.
We want you to play it, enjoy it, and tell us what you think![/p][p]Please share your feedback on:[/p][list][*][p]💬 Our official [b]Discord server[/b][/p][/*][*][p]💬 The [b]Steam community forums and comments section[/b][/p][/*][*][p]💬 Our [b]social media channels[/b][/p][/*][/list][p]Your thoughts will help us polish the game, improve the experience, and continue building the [b]Aeterna universe together[/b].[/p][hr][/hr][h2]✨ [b]What is Aeterna Lucis?[/b][/h2][p][b]Aeterna Lucis[/b] is a handcrafted metroidvania that expands the dark and beautiful universe of [i]Aeterna Noctis[/i] with a brand-new story, new characters, and a bold artistic direction.[/p][p]Here’s what makes it unique:[/p][list][*][p]🎨 [b]Fully hand-painted art style[/b], now in an immersive [b]2.5D world[/b] with depth and dynamic movement.[/p][/*][*][p]🔦 [b]Dynamic lighting[/b] that transforms the atmosphere and exploration of every area.[/p][/*][*][p]🌀 [b]Seamless transitions between zones[/b], with no loading times — pure immersion.[/p][/*][*][p]⚔️ Precision-based combat and platforming, crafted for players who love a good challenge.[/p][/*][/list][p]And of course, it keeps our signature tone: a world both [b]haunting and beautiful[/b], full of secrets, choices, and surprises around every corner.[/p][hr][/hr][h2]🕹️ [b]Download the demo now![/b][/h2][p]The demo is available for a limited time as part of the [b]#SteamNextFest[/b].
This is your chance to [b]play it before anyone else[/b], help us improve it, and be part of its journey.[/p][p]🔗 [url="https://store.steampowered.com/app/2710920/Aeterna_Lucis"]Download Aeterna Lucis Demo[/url][/p]

notes.title: 🔥 Today we reveal the first Aeterna Lucis teaser! 🔥
notes.notes:
🌟 The story continues…
The gods have spoken. The battle between Light and Darkness rages on, and today you will witness the first preview of the epic sequel to Aeterna Noctis: Aeterna Lucis.

🎬 First anime teaser
Immerse yourself in the stunning anime aesthetic that brings this new chapter to life. Discover a renewed world, iconic characters, and new threats that will challenge fate itself.

Challenging action, demanding platforming, and refined gameplay await in this new installment. Today is the day you get a first look at the universe of Aeterna Lucis.

👀 Don’t miss it
Follow our Steam page and social media to be among the first to see it. The Light has awakened!
